what: When the section reaches 90% of the screen, the picture pieces gathered at scale 0 at center (left 50%) and the bottom pop out to their own places in .6s while growing (cubic-bezier(0, .55, .45, 1)). The character riding on a piece rises from 20px below in .4s after a .3s delay (once). It is the section decoration where speech bubbles burst above and below the card.

options.from: If “top”, it spreads down from the top edge (top 0) — the bottom row of the card. The default rises from the bottom (bottom 0)
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Pieces that fly out — the consuming CSS gives position:absolute and the resting spot (left and bottom, with from: top, left and top). It must be there
options.[data-fx-part=rider]: (if present) Whatever rides on top of the piece — rises in from 20px below, .3s later

from.where: index.html .ns-balloons (eight speech bubbles above and below the person section cards)
